summary: Soundscape: a five-bus audio layout, ambience chosen from the snapshot by region x time segment x weather, one stable audio cue reference per battle event kind and per skill presentation cue, a four-state music machine, and a deterministic in-repo synth that renders every record as a marked procedural placeholder.

coordination.notes: content/skills/*.json is touched for the audioCueId field only -- one stable reference per presentation cue, mirroring vfxId, held equal to the cue's existing free-text audio label by the validator so the two cannot drift. tools/src/validate.mjs takes one appended block plus that one skill-cue field. game/project.godot takes an appended autoload and an appended [audio] section. No Rust, no ui/, no battle/, no render/ file is touched: P6 calls Soundscape.on_battle_event and the surface calls Soundscape.set_music_state, and the API they call is documented in soundscape.gd's header.
